name: happyinternet
description: Plugins for a happier internet to read and engage with.

plugins.name: slop-stopper
plugins.description: Stop sounding like everyone else on the internet. We deserve better. Slop Stopper is a final review for anything you publish or send: it removes AI tells and formulaic writing, improves structure and headings, tightens the draft for its real reader, and checks facts, numbers and links. Works on LinkedIn posts, emails, blogs, webpages, reports and proposals. Never invents.
